full_sentence: My sister always wakes up early on Sundays.

options.why_wrong: 'My sister' is third person singular, so the verb needs -s: 'wakes'.
The -ing form cannot be the main verb after the subject here. The simple present needs a plain verb form.

options.text: did wake up early on Sundays.
options.why_wrong: 'Did' is past tense, but 'always' describes a regular habit, so the present simple is needed.

grammar_focus: Third person singular -s in the present simple
explanation: The subject 'my sister' is third person singular, so the verb takes -s in the present simple. Turkish speakers may forget the -s because Turkish verb endings show the person in a different way from English.
